title: Warm French Chicken Blanquette
description: A hearty and flavorful French dish from Normandy, featuring chicken, mushrooms, and fresh thyme, cooked in a clay pot and served in a paella pan. This blanquette is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and black pepper.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in the paella pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken thighs to the pan and cook until browned on both sides.
Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter to the pan.
Add the sliced onions to the pan and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook until they are tender.
Add the fresh thyme sprigs to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the onions and mushrooms and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the chicken broth and heavy cream to the pan, whisking constantly.
Return the chicken to the pan and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, until the chicken is cooked through.
